about: The weapons as the player saw them on the lock-in round (round 4, 2026-11-06): their text and proposed chapters, frozen before the lock-in build cut seven and changed others, so page3.mjs can still draw that round.

airstrike.name: Air Strike
levels: Each tap sends a jet down that row, hitting everything under it (2 rounds a jet)
A wider run, harder hits
The row burns for 2 s and subs and trucks under it are destroyed

shrapnel.name: Shrapnel Shell
levels: Each shell bursts into 10 fragments that fly out in every direction
14 fragments that fly further
18 fragments that tear through everything in their path

frigate.name: Frigate Escort
levels: Two frigates sail in and fire on their own while it lasts
They fire half again as fast
A third frigate joins, and they fire faster still

thermo.name: Thermobaric Shell
levels: Each shell bursts in a huge blast that hits everything in it
A bigger blast that hits for 2
The biggest blast, hitting for 3

scatter.name: Scattergun
levels: Each tap fires a short blast of 8 pellets from the gun toward your finger
11 pellets, reaching further
15 pellets that tear through everything in their path

boomerang.name: Boomerang
levels: Each tap throws a blade out to the threat and back, cutting everything on both passes
A wider blade that cuts for 2
Two blades at once

flak.name: Flak Cannon
levels: Each shell leaves a flak cloud for 1.5 s that hits whatever flies through
A bigger cloud that hangs for 2 s
Clouds hang for 4 s, a wall the swarm has to fly through

seeker.name: Seeker Pod
levels: Each tap launches 3 seekers at the threats nearest your finger, each a third of a shot
4 seekers a tap
5 seekers, and one whose target is gone finds another

aegis.name: Aegis Launchers
levels: Every ship carries an interceptor that fires on its own at a threat about to hit it
Two a ship, fired from further out
Spent ones reload every 3 s, and the carrier fires its own

well.name: Gravity Well
levels: Each shell opens a vortex that drags threats in for 1.5 s, then implodes on them
A wider pull and a harder implosion
It holds for 2 s and the implosion hits for 4

railgun.name: Railgun
levels: Each shot is a beam that pierces everything in line
Twice the damage, a wider beam
Wide slugs, four times as hard: two bring down a heavy missile

tesla.name: Tesla Arc
levels: Every hit arcs to 3 threats nearby
4 arcs per hit, and every arc arcs again
Each tap fires a second, free shot at a threat nearby

cutter.name: Laser Cutter
levels: Swipe across threats: everything under your finger is cut (one round a swipe)
A longer cut
The cut stays lit for 1 s and burns what flies into it

lance.name: Charge Lance
levels: Tap for a quick shot; hold to charge: half for a 3-hit bolt, full for a 6-hit lance through everything in line
Charges a third faster, and the half bolt pierces
A full lance leaves a burning line for 2 s

chainshot.name: Chain Shot
levels: Tap one threat, then another nearby: a chain drags them together for 2 hits each
A longer chain, 3 hits each
A third tap adds a third link, and links hit for 4

firecontrol.name: Fire Control
levels: Taps mark up to 6 targets; moments later the salvo fires at all of them at once, a round for every two
Up to 8 marks, 0.5 s wait
Marked threats take 2 hits each

grapnel.name: Grapnel
levels: Hold on a threat to hook it, drag to swing it into others (2 hits each), let go to fling it
The cable reaches across the whole sea
The flung threat explodes for 3 in a wide blast

cadence.name: Cadence Gun
levels: Fire on the beat for a 3-hit shot that pierces; off the beat, a normal shot
A wider beat window
Four beats in a row, and the fifth fires a free broadside

droneScreen.name: Drone Screen
levels: Your own drones lift off the carrier one after another and ram the threats closest to your ships
A drone every 0.9 s
A drone every 0.7 s, and each ram bursts, hitting everything around it

gunships.name: Gunship Pair
levels: Two helicopters hover over the convoy and rocket the thickest cluster near it
They fire half again as often
A third helicopter joins, and each pod hits for 2

bomberWing.name: Bomber Wing
levels: Bombers hit the shore: trucks are destroyed; the busiest silo or tunnel goes quiet for 6 s, its launches cancelled
A pass every 4.5 s
A pass every 3.5 s, each hitting two targets, a surfaced sub too; silos stay silent for 8 s

orbital.name: Orbital Strike
levels: Laser dots close in on the toughest thing on screen, then a beam from orbit hits it for 3 (and what is around it for 1)
A strike every 1.8 s
A strike every 1.2 s, and the beam lingers onto the next toughest

fireAtWill.name: Fire at Will
levels: Hold to fire full-auto (every 0.2 s), whatever is loaded; the rack holds 4 more
Every 0.15 s, the rack holds 6 more, and it reloads twice as fast
Every 4th shot bursts into flak

supplyRun.name: Supply Run
levels: Kills drop twice as much, and drops fly straight to the carrier
Three times as much
And every 6 s a crate lands holding one of your weapons

overclock.name: Overclock
levels: The loaded weapon plays a level higher and its clock stops (nothing loaded: the next one). Already at MAX: it drops more often too
Every weapon picked up while it lasts is overclocked too
The loaded weapon jumps straight to MAX

hotStreak.name: Hot Streak
levels: Hits in a row heat the gun: 5 and shots do double, 10 and triple. A miss resets it
Double at 4, triple at 8
At 10 shots pierce, and a miss no longer resets it

dualWield.name: Dual Wield
levels: The next weapon picked up joins the loaded one: every tap fires both, for one round
Both clocks run at half speed
And weapons drop twice as often while it lasts

focus.name: Focus
levels: Up to 6 s of half-speed time, spent only while a finger is down
9 s, at a third of the speed
Shots fired in slow motion hit for double

wildCard.name: Wild Card
levels: With nothing loaded, each tap fires a random active weapon's level 1 shot
A random active or passive, at level 2
A random active weapon's MAX shot

overdrive.name: Overdrive
levels: Rounds cost nothing
And the rack keeps refilling, so it is full when the boost ends
Every shot fires twice

timeWarp.name: Time Warp
levels: Every threat moves at 40% speed; the world drains of colour and sound drops
25% speed
The first 2 s near-stopped (10%), then 25%

shield.name: Shield
levels: Ships and the carrier take no damage from missiles, drones and boats
It blocks a strafing run too, and shatters doing it
A blocked missile bounces back and bursts

fullSteam.name: Full Steam
levels: The convoy steams at 1.6× speed
2× speed
Ships at full steam ram drones and boats out of the water

tidal.name: Tidal Cannon
levels: Tap a boat, a mine or open water: a wave rolls out 300 px and swamps boats, mines, surfaced subs and drones diving low. Missiles fly over it (a tap on one is a plain shot)
420 px, and it shoves what it passes back the way it came
The wave rolls across the whole sea

storm.name: Storm Front
levels: A storm cell drifts across with the wind: lightning hits a drone or aircraft in it every 0.8 s, and half the missiles crossing it are blown off course
A bigger, slower cell
Two cells

ammoShip.name: Ammunition Ship
levels: An ammunition ship joins the convoy: while it floats the rack reloads twice as fast. The enemy goes for it (sunk, it isn't a lost ship)
Reloads 2.5× as fast, and takes 6 hits
And it fires a free round at the nearest threat every 2 s
